lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Iceland through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset includes approximately 134.4 thousand mapped buildings with structural metadata (levels, materials) and address information, representing approximately 45% of estimated total buildings based on AI-mapping validation.
